commands.stack: FAROL_AI_URL=http://ai:11434 docker compose -p farol-234 -f infra/compose.yaml --env-file infra/.env.example --profile ai up -d --wait --wait-timeout 600 (images built from this branch with docker build -t farol-<service>:dev backend/<service>, and frontend)

profile_note: Proposed, for the team's review (spec 234 D1): NFR-03 and the runtime contract state no arrival rate. One request every 30 s on a fixed schedule (open model), 72 requests, 36 minutes per run. Participants Rita, Sofia, Inês and Nuno in turn (each every 2 minutes); Miguel, in a Control room team with HelpRequests.Triage, polls the list and the triage status every 2 s. Logins happen before the first submission; access tokens are renewed with their refresh token.

pass_rules.sc3: Pass when the valid suggestions stored within 30 s are at least 95 % of the 66 non-abstention cases (ADR-005 offline definition). Valid: state Suggested with a category and a priority stored at most 30 000 ms after submission, both times Reports' own (help_request.submitted_at, triage_suggestion.updated_at). A request still Pending with no reason after its deadline is a Timeout; abstentions, errors, invalid and late outputs are misses. Reported beside it, not part of the pass: the NFR-03 count over all 72 (expected abstentions are misses there), p50, p95 (nearest rank) and max of the end-to-end time of the stored suggestions, fallbacks by reason, the worker's model time.
pass_rules.sc5: Pass when every one of the 72 requests appears in the operator's list and reads NotTriaged with a reason at a poll no later than 32 000 ms after it was sent (30 s deadline plus one 2 s poll), and no poll shows them out of order of arrival.

fixture: Reports' local copies hold one new event per run: a team 'Control room' (HelpRequests.Triage) and five RegularUser memberships, written with SQL as MembershipChanged and TeamChanged would write them (US-12 and US-18 answer 501 in Auth & Users; Events publishes no TeamChanged yet). Spec 234 D2.
